items.text: कृत्तिकादिषु ऋक्षेषु विषमेष्वम्बु यद्दिवः दृष्टार्कं पतितं ज्ञेयं तद्गाङ्गं दिग्गजोज्झितम्

items.text: पराशर उवाच इत्युक्ते मौनिनं भूयश्चिन्तयानं महीपतिम् प्रत्युवाचाथ विप्रो ऽसावद्वैतान्तर्गतां कथाम्

items.text: ब्राह्मण उवाच श्रूयतां नृपशार्दूल यद्गीतमृभुणा पुरा अवबोधं जनयता निदाघस्य द्विजन्मनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऋभुर्नामाभवत्पुत्रो ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः विज्ञाततत्त्वसद्भावो निसर्गादेव भूपते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तस्य शिष्यो निदाघो ऽभूत्पुलस्त्यतनयः पुरा प्रादादशेषविज्ञानं स तस्मै परया मुदा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अवाप्तज्ञानतत्त्वस्य न तस्याद्वैतवासनाम् स ऋभुस्तर्कयामास निदाघस्य नरेश्वर
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: देविकायास्तटे वीरनगरं नाम वै पुरम् समृद्धमतिरम्यं च पुलस्त्येन निवेशितम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: रम्योपवनपर्यन्ते स तस्मिन्पार्थिवोत्तम निदाघो नाम योगज्ञ ऋभुशिष्यो ऽवसत्पुरा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: दिव्ये वर्षसहस्रे तु समतीते ऽस्य तत्पुरम् जगाम स ऋभुः शिष्यं निदाघमवलोकितुम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: स तस्य वैश्वदेवान्ते द्वारालोकनगोचरे स्थितस्तेन गृहीतार्घो निजवेश्मप्रवेशितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: प्रक्षालिताङ्घ्रिपाणिं च कृतासनपरिग्रहमुवाच स द्विजश्रेष्ठो भुज्यतामिति सादरम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऋभुरुवाच भो विप्रवर्य भोक्तव्यं यदन्नं भवतो गृहे तत्कथ्यतां कदन्नेषु न प्रीतिः सततं मम
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: निदाघ उवाच सक्तुयावकवाट्यानामपूपानां च मे गृहे यद्रोचते द्विजश्रेष्ठ तत्त्वं भुङ्क्ष्व यथेच्छया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऋभुरुवाच कदन्नानि द्विजैतानि मिष्टमन्नं प्रयच्छ मे संयावपायसादीनि द्रप्सफाणितवन्ति च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: निदाघ उवाच हे हे शालिनि मद्गेहे यत्किंचिदतिशोभनम् भक्ष्योपसाधनं मिष्टं तेनास्यान्नं प्रसाधय
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ब्राह्मण उवाच इत्युक्ता तेन सा पत्नी मिष्टमन्नं द्विजस्य यत्प्रसाधितवती तद्वै भर्तुर्वचनगौरवात्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तं भुक्तवन्तमिच्छातो मिष्टमन्नं महामुनिम् निदाघः प्राह भूपाल प्रश्रयावनतः स्थितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: निदाघ उवाच अपि ते परमा तृप्तिरुत्पन्ना तुष्टिरेव च अपि ते मानसं स्वस्थमाहारेण कृतं द्विज
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: क्वनिवासो भवान्विप्र क्व च गन्तुं समुद्यतः आगम्यते च भवता यतस्तच्च द्विजोच्यताम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऋभुरुवाच क्षुद्यस्य तस्य भुक्ते ऽन्ने तृप्तिर्ब्राह्मण जायते न मे क्षुदभवत्तृप्तिं कस्मान्मां परिपृच्छसि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: वह्निना पार्थिवे धातौ क्षपिते क्षुत्समुद्भवः भवत्यम्भसि च क्षीणे नृणां तृडपि जायते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: क्षुत्तृष्णे देहधर्माख्ये न ममैते यतो द्विज ततः क्षुत्संभवाभावात्तृप्तिरस्त्येव मे सदा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: मनसः स्वस्थता तुष्टिश्चित्तधर्माविमौ द्विज चेतसो यस्य तत्पृच्छ पुमानेभिर्न युज्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: क्व निवासस्तवेत्युक्तं क्व गन्तासि च यत्त्वया कुतश्चागम्यते तत्र त्रितये ऽपि निबोध मे
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पुमान्सर्वगतो व्यापी आकाशवदयं यतः कुतः कुत्र क्व गन्तासीत्येतदप्यर्थवत्कथम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सो ऽहं गन्ता न चागन्ता नैकदेशनिकेतनः त्वं चान्ये च न च त्वं च नान्ये नैवाहमप्यहम्

items.text: मृष्टं न मृष्टमित्येषा जिज्ञासा मे कृता तव किं वक्ष्यतीति तत्रापि श्रूयतां द्विजसत्तम
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: किमस्वाद्वथ वा मृष्टं भुञ्जतो ऽन्नं द्विजोत्तम मृष्टमेव यदामृष्टं तदेवोद्वेगकारणम्

items.text: अमृष्टं जायते मृष्टं मृष्टादुद्विजते जनः आदिमध्यावसानेषु किमन्नं रुचिकारकम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: मृण्मयं हि गृहं यद्वन्मृदा लिप्तं स्थिरं भवेत्पार्थिवो ऽयं तथा देहः पार्थिवैः परमाणुभिः

items.text: यवगोधूममुद्गादि घृतं तैलं पयो दधि गुडं फलादीनि तथा पार्थिवाः परमाणवः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तदेतद्भवता ज्ञात्वा मृष्टामृष्टविचारि यत्तन्मनः समतालम्बि कार्यं साम्यं हि मुक्तये
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ब्राह्मण उवाच इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य परमार्थाश्रितं नृप प्रणिपत्य महाभागो निदाघो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: प्रसीद मद्धितार्थाय कथ्यतां यस्त्वमागतः नष्टो मोहस्तवाकर्ण्य वचांस्येतानि मे द्विज
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऋभुरुवाच ऋभुरस्मि तवाचार्यः प्रज्ञादानाय ते द्विज इहागतो ऽहं यास्यामि परमार्थस्तवोदितः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एवमेकमिदं विद्धि न भेदि सकलं जगत् वासुदेवाभिधेयस्य स्वरूपं परमात्मनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ब्राह्मण उवाच तथेत्युक्त्वा निदाघेन प्रणिपातपुरःसरम् पूजितः परया भक्त्या इच्छातः प्रययावृभुः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ब्राह्मण उवाच ऋभुर्वर्षसहस्रे तु समतीते नरेश्वर निदाघज्ञानदानाय तदेव नगरं ययौ
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नगरस्य बहिः सो ऽथ निदाघं ददृशे मुनिः महाबलपरीवारे पुरं विशति पार्थिवे
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: दूरे स्थितं महाभागं जनसंमर्दवर्जकम् क्षुत्क्षामकण्ठमायान्तमरण्यात्ससमित्कुशम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: दृष्ट्वा निदाघं स ऋभुरुपगम्याभिवाद्य च उवाच कस्मादेकान्ते स्थीयते भवता द्विज
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: निदाघ उवाच भो विप्र जनसंमर्दो महानेष नरेश्वरे प्रविविक्षौ पुरं रम्यं तेनात्र स्थीयते मया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऋभुरुवाच नराधिपो ऽत्र कतमः कतमश्चेतरो जनः कथ्यतां मे द्विजश्रेष्ठ त्वमभिज्ञो मतो मम
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: निदाघ उवाच यो ऽयं गजेन्द्रमुन्मत्तमद्रिशृङ्गसमुच्छ्रितमधिरूढो नरेन्द्रो ऽयं परिलोकस्तथेतरः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऋभुरुवाच एतौ हि गजराजानौ युगपद्दर्शितौ मम भवता न विशेषेण पृथक्चिह्नोपलक्षणौ
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तत्कथ्यतां महाभाग विशेषो भवतानयोः ज्ञातुमिच्छाम्यहं को ऽत्र गजः को वा नराधिपः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: निदाघ उवाच गजो यो ऽयमधो ब्रह्मन्नुपर्यस्यैव भूपतिः वाह्यवाहकसंबन्धं को न जानाति वै द्विज
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऋभुरुवाच जानाम्यहं यथा ब्रह्मंस्तथा मामवबोधय अधःशब्दनिगद्यं किं किं चोर्ध्वमभिधीयते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ब्राह्मण उवाच इत्युक्तः सहसारुह्य निदाघः प्राह तमृभुम् श्रूयतां कथयाम्येष यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: उपर्यहं यथा राजा त्वमधः कुञ्जरो यथा अवबोधाय ते ब्रह्मन्दृष्टान्तो दर्शितो मया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऋभुरुवाच त्वं राजेव द्विजश्रेष्ठ स्थितो ऽहं गजवद्यदि तदेव त्वं ममाचक्ष्व कतमस्त्वमहं तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ब्राह्मण उवाच इत्युक्तः सत्वरस्तस्य प्रगृह्य चरणावुभौ निदाघः प्राह भगवानाचार्यस्त्वमृभुर्ध्रुवम्

items.text: नान्यस्याद्वैतसंस्कारसंस्कृतं मानसं तथा यथाचार्यस्य तेन त्वां मन्ये प्राप्तमहं गुरुम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ऋभुरुवाच तवोपदेशदानाय पूर्वशुश्रूषणादृतः गुरुस्ते ऽहमृभुर्नाम्ना निदाघ समुपागतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तदेतदुपदिष्टं ते संक्षेपेण महामते परमार्थसारभूतं यदद्वैतमशेषतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ब्राह्मण उवाच एवमुक्त्वा ययौ विद्वान्निदाघं स ऋभुर्गुरुः निदाघो ऽप्युपदेशेन तेनाद्वैतपरो ऽभवत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सर्वभूतान्यभेदेन ददृशे स तदात्मनः तथा ब्रह्म ततो मुक्तिमवाप परमां द्विजः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तथा त्वमपि धर्मज्ञ तुल्यात्मरिपुबान्धवः भव सर्वगतं जानन्नात्मानमवनीपते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सितनीलादिभेदेन यथैकं दृश्यते नभः भ्रान्तदृष्टिभिरात्मापि तथैकः सन्पृथक्पृथक्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एकः समस्तं यदिहास्ति किंचित्तदच्युतो वास्ति परं ततो ऽन्यत्सो ऽहं स च त्वं स च सर्वमेतदात्मस्वरूपं त्यज भेदमोहम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पराशर उवाच इतीरितस्तेन स राजवर्यस्तत्याज भेदं परमार्थदृष्टिः स चापि जातिस्मरणाप्तबोधस्तत्रैव जन्मन्यपवर्गमाप
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: इति भरतनरेन्द्रसारवृत्तं कथयति यश्च शृणोति भक्तियुक्तः स विमलमतिरेति नात्ममोहं भवति च संसरणेषु मुक्तियोग्यः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).
